name: EPIC 201638795
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 7.4 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201638795 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.35324 (16th-84th percentiles 7.090151-7.646098), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201638795 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.947948 (16th-84th percentiles 0.862024-1.048926), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201638795: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4785.117 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201638795 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3570.9375 (16th-84th percentiles 3461.210938-3685.859375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.14 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,571 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.95 solar masses and 7.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,785 K at its surface.
